reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: repay_amount has active non-test callers (market.move:486, market.move:787), the entry point is a public user-facing repay action (no trust_assumptions defined, untrusted caller), and reserve.move is explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the public repay entry point by acting as first depositor — borrowing to create fractional debt, waiting for interest accrual, then repaying exactly ceil(debt) tokens — causing the branch at reserve.move:L206 to compute cash_reserve += coin.value() - ceil(debt) = 0 while cash gains the full coin.value(), leaking the fractional surplus ceil(debt)-debt into the ctoken exchange rate; a subsequent victim depositing a small amount then receives floor(amount/inflated_rate) = 0 ctokens due to unguarded floor division in mint_ctokens, losing their entire deposit to the attacker.
